% glossaries with xindy, \noist, and a xindy style file next to the
% document, test-glossaries-xdy.xdy, whose markup prints a line above the
% glossary
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage[xindy]{glossaries}
\noist
\setStyleFile{test-glossaries-xdy}
\makeglossaries
\newglossaryentry{group}{name={group},
  description={a set with an associative operation}}
\begin{document}
A \gls{group}.
\printglossaries
\end{document}
